summary: The user deposited funds into NC Wallet and reported that withdrawals were restricted immediately after the deposit. The funds remained inaccessible for approximately one month while the user reported continued withdrawal restrictions.
user_mistake: deposited funds into a wallet service without confirming withdrawals
prevention: Complete a small deposit and withdrawal before committing additional funds to a custodial wallet service / Stop depositing funds while withdrawals remain restricted
classification_warning: insufficient detail to confirm intentional scam
